title: Eliminate Access Denied flash and force SignedOut landing on initial load

requirements.summary: Always render the signed-out landing (Features + Sign in) for unauthenticated users during initial load, with no Access Denied UI at any time while signed out.
acceptanceCriteria: Open the site in a fresh Incognito window: the first screen shown is the Features + Sign in landing screen (SignedOutScreen).
At no point during initial load (including while auth state initializes) does an “Access Denied” screen appear for a signed-out user.
No route/state in the app renders or navigates to an Access Denied screen/component for a signed-out user.

file_operations.description: Change top-level initial render logic so that while Internet Identity is initializing and the user is not yet authenticated, the app renders SignedOutScreen (Features + Sign in) instead of any intermediate state that could expose protected UI or an authorization error/denied state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Harden authorization failure handling so any auth/permission-related startup error triggers logout, cache clearing, and returns to SignedOutScreen without relying on a single error string.
acceptanceCriteria: If the backend returns an authorization failure during profile loading, the app logs the user out (clears Internet Identity session in-app) and shows the signed-out landing screen instead of showing an Access Denied page.
The authorization error handling does not rely on a single exact error string; common authorization/permission-denied variants are handled consistently.
After the session is cleared due to an auth error, React Query caches are cleared/invalidated so protected queries do not keep failing in a loop.

file_operations.description: Add a small utility that detects authorization/permission-denied failures robustly across common variants (e.g., unauthorized/forbidden/permission denied/not authorized/authentication required), supporting different error shapes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the current 'Unauthorized' substring check with the new authorization error detector; on detected auth failure during authenticated startup (e.g., profile load), clear the Internet Identity session via useInternetIdentity.clear() and clear/invalidate React Query caches to prevent retry loops, then ensure the signed-out landing is shown. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove any renderable Access Denied screen from the runtime bundle and ensure no code path can import/render it.
acceptanceCriteria: There is no working AccessDeniedScreen UI that can be rendered by the app in any state.
A code search for rendering/route usage of an Access Denied screen returns no active usages (imports/references that can render UI).
Refreshing the app repeatedly while signed out never shows an Access Denied card/page.

file_operations.description: Delete the AccessDeniedScreen implementation file so it cannot be bundled or rendered at runtime; remove any remaining imports/usages elsewhere as needed to keep the app compiling and to ensure no renderable Access Denied UI exists.
